trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy awarded for earning all other 54 trophies in the game. Focus on completing the story first, then clean up collectibles and activities. No specific action required beyond earning everything else. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' which serves as the game's tutorial. This mission introduces the dual-protagonist mechanic and basic controls. It unlocks automatically as you start the game. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all missions in Chapter 1 of the main story. This chapter establishes the setting in Leonida and introduces key characters. Simply progress through the narrative missions marked on your map. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all missions in Chapter 2. The story expands into Vice City proper with new criminal enterprises. Follow the main mission markers to advance the chapter. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's storyline missions. This chapter deepens the conflict with rival gangs and cartels. Continue following the primary mission path to complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the final chapter of the main story. This concludes the primary narrative arc before the finale. All story missions in this chapter must be finished. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission of the game. This gold trophy marks the end of the main campaign. Simply play through to the conclusion of the narrative. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' mission, an early story mission introducing key mechanics. This is a mandatory story mission that cannot be missed. Progress naturally through the campaign. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish 'The Cartel Heist' mission, a major story heist sequence. This mission features a significant set piece with multiple phases. It unlocks as part of the main story progression. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' story mission. This mission develops the relationship between the protagonists. Follow the main mission marker to trigger and complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the 'Headliners' story mission. This mission features a major concert set piece. Progress through the main story to reach and complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Cargo Load' story mission. This mission involves vehicle hijacking and chase sequences. It is part of the main campaign and cannot be missed. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the 'Whiteout' story mission. This mission takes place in a unique environmental setting with reduced visibility. Follow the main mission path to complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieve 100% completion of all main story missions. This requires finishing every chapter and the final mission. Simply play through the entire campaign to unlock this naturally. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Find and successfully land all 50 stunt jumps scattered across Leonida. Use a fast motorcycle or sports car for best results. Each jump requires a clean landing — use quick-save/load if available. PowerPyx has a mapped route for efficient collection. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Win a race in each vehicle class.
trophies.guide: Win at least one race in every vehicle class (sports, super, muscle, off-road, motorcycle, boat, etc.). Races unlock as you explore. Focus on one class at a time; lower-difficulty races count. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Complete all shooting range challenges with gold medals.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals on every shooting range challenge. Practice each weapon's recoil pattern and aim for headshots. The ranges unlock progressively; revisit earlier ones with better weapons if needed. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.gamerguides.com/grand-theft-auto-vi/trophy-guide/

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.guide: Play and complete every carnival/minigame activity (arcade cabinets, fairground games, etc.) found around Leonida. These are marked on the map once discovered. No high scores needed — just complete each once. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.description: Complete a heist without killing anyone.
trophies.guide: Finish any heist mission using only non-lethal takedowns or stealth. Use melee takedowns, suppressed weapons, or avoid enemies entirely. The 'Quiet Exit' approach works well. Save before the heist to retry if detected. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.guide: Catch one of the rare legendary fish. These require specific bait, locations, and times (often night or specific weather). Check the fishing log for hints. The 'Golden Tarpon' in the Everglades area is a common first catch. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.gamerguides.com/grand-theft-auto-vi/trophy-guide/

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Chain 50 drift combos across any vehicles. Use a rear-wheel-drive car with drift tires on wide roads or the airport runway. Hold handbrake + steer to initiate, counter-steer to maintain. Combos count cumulatively across sessions. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Rehab' story mission. This mission is part of the main campaign and unlocks naturally during story progression. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.guide: Finish 'The Arrangement' story mission. A water-focused mission with boat combat and chase sequences. Follow the main mission markers to complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.guide: Complete 'The Long Drive' story mission. An extended driving sequence across the map. Simply follow the GPS route and reach the destination. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.guide: Finish every stranger and freak mission strand in the game. These side missions are marked with '?' icons on the map. Some unlock only after specific story progress or at certain times of day. Check the mission log to track completion. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Supply Lines' story mission. This mission involves securing supply routes for your organization. Follow the objectives to finish it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.guide: Complete the 'DJ Set' story mission. A unique mission involving music and nightlife elements. Progress the story to unlock and complete it. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.guide: Collect all mental health awareness collectibles hidden across the map. These are missable if you progress past certain story points without collecting them. Use a map guide (PowerPyx has an interactive map) and collect them as early as possible. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.guide: Locate and collect all hunting-related collectibles (animal trophies, rare pelts, tracking markers). These are scattered in wilderness areas. Use the hunter's lodge as a base and check your collector's log for progress. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find all 30 skateboard decks hidden throughout Vice City and the Keys. They glow faintly at night and emit a subtle sound. The skate park in Little Haiti is a good starting zone. Use a collectibles map for the last few. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Collect all WAiN (Wireless Audio Information Network) radio collectibles. These are hidden in interiors, on rooftops, and in vehicles. The in-game radio app tracks your progress. Check parking garages and billboards. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish the final remaining activity on your map. This unlocks naturally when you've completed all other activities, races, and challenges. Check the activities tab in the pause menu for any missing entries. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Survive a 5-star wanted level for 10 minutes.
trophies.guide: Reach 5-star wanted level and survive for 10 real-time minutes. Use a tank (Rhino) or armored vehicle, or hide in a subway tunnel / parking garage. The military will spawn aggressively; stay mobile. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 20 stores in a single session.
trophies.guide: Rob 20 convenience stores, liquor stores, or gas stations without dying or losing the cops. Start in a dense urban area (Downtown Vice City) and move quickly between targets. Use a fast getaway car. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.description: Destroy 50 vehicles with a tow truck.
trophies.guide: Use a tow truck to destroy 50 vehicles by ramming or dropping them. The tow truck spawns at the impound lot and certain industrial areas. Park near traffic, hook cars, and slam them into walls. Cumulative across sessions. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.guide: Accumulate 100 headshot kills using any pistol. This tracks across the entire playthrough. Use free-aim mode and target practice at shooting ranges or during combat. The AP Pistol works well for rate of fire. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Escape a 4-star wanted level on foot.
trophies.guide: Reach 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops without entering a vehicle. Use alleys, sewers, building interiors, and the subway system. Break line of sight and hide until the search radius passes. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Destroy a Rhino tank on foot.
trophies.guide: Destroy a military Rhino tank while on foot. Use RPG, grenades, sticky bombs, or the railgun. Tanks spawn at 5-star wanted level or at Fort Zancudo. Aim for the rear engine grille for critical damage. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Complete a heist entirely in stealth.
trophies.guide: Finish any heist from start to finish without triggering an alarm. Use suppressed weapons, melee takedowns, and hack cameras. Plan your route during the setup phase. The 'Art Gallery' heist is well-suited for stealth. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.gamerguides.com/grand-theft-auto-vi/trophy-guide/

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete a heist with a take exceeding $1,000,000. Choose the maximum payout approach during planning, hire the best crew (they take a larger cut but perform better), and execute flawlessly. The 'Casino Vault' heist has the highest potential. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.guide: During a specific heist setup mission, arrange the crew and equipment to mirror the 'Blitz Play' from GTA V. This is an easter egg trophy — select the heavy crew, use the tow truck, and position the blockade truck exactly as prompted. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Set foot in every named region/neighborhood across the map (Vice City, Keys, Everglades, Grassrivers, etc.). The map reveals regions as you enter them. Fast travel or drive the perimeter to hit any missed zones. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.guide: Shoot or run over 100 pigeons (flying rats) scattered across the map. They perch on ledges, signs, and rooftops. Use a silenced sniper rifle for rooftop birds. The in-game counter tracks progress. PowerPyx has a full location map. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.guide: Start a new game from the main menu. This unlocks immediately upon beginning a fresh playthrough. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a dramatic exit. Drive a vehicle through the showroom windows during a mission or free roam. The showroom is in a major city district (Downtown Vice City). Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley in Vice City. Complete a full game (10 frames). The alley is marked on the map once discovered. No high score required — just finish the game. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Experience a partnership moment with mass appeal. This occurs during a specific story beat with your partner character. Progress the story to trigger this narrative moment. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices tracked by the PSN system (500 total across playthroughs). Dialogue choices and mission approaches count. This accumulates naturally over multiple playthroughs or a thorough single run. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt after failing a mission or objective. Simply retry and complete any failed mission. This happens naturally during normal play. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange/unexplained event in the world. These are rare random encounters or specific locations with odd phenomena. Explore remote areas at night for best chances (e.g., the Everglades swamp lights). Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi, https://www.gamerguides.com/grand-theft-auto-vi/trophy-guide/

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian with a melee drive-by attack. Lean out the window of a moving vehicle and melee strike a pedestrian. Requires timing and vehicle control. Best done in a slow-moving convertible. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your criminal contacts. Marked Bills are earned from heists and robberies. Visit laundering contacts regularly to process the money. This accumulates over the playthrough. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shops and services. Buy weapons, vehicles, clothes, properties, and upgrades. This accumulates naturally while playing. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties available for sale. Garages unlock as you progress and earn money. Check the property menu and buy each one as it becomes available. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks mid-game; use it to register vehicles you own or steal. Each unique vehicle counts once. Source: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
